Buttons, sliders & screens

A project-wide source inventory. The table connects registered artifacts to possible interface dependencies and configured map cells. It does not count live widgets or certify working controls. Shared factories, optional branches and inherited resources can broaden an artifact's results.

Text surfaces include labels; viewport surfaces include render targets. Neither automatically means a user-facing screen. Source view retains passive naming hints, signal connections and input polling separately in the downloadable evidence.
